question: Can LegalEase prepare the participant-facing portion of the form or packet, leave external sections incomplete, and instruct the participant how to obtain the required signature, certificate, or document?
note: Candidates only. Nothing here is reclassified by this script or by engineering. Counsel answers the question; a yes produces a revised memo, a no leaves the track on process guidance. Tracks whose rationale includes negotiation, individualized advocacy, a contested evidentiary showing, or no participant filing existing are deliberately absent.

destination.name: Superior Court of the District of Columbia and relevant agencies
destination.detail: There is nothing to file. LegalEase verifies whether the record is still publicly visible, tracks the statutory deadline, and routes to a motion track or legal aid if relief does not arrive.

preserved.reason: Carries a rationale that makes guidance the right output regardless of what we could prepare.
